title: Chapter 308 Seven-Star Zerg Nest
content:
Chapter 308 Seven-Star Zerg Nest

In the ancient desert territory, the tribes of various desert races that have become followers of evil gods are full of chaotic people packing their bags. They will follow the will of the gods and head for the unknown distance.

No one can disobey the will of the gods.

The important personnel of each desert race, with a large amount of wealth in the tribe, were the first to use convenient transportation and evacuate quickly.

The remaining tribesmen evacuated in order of importance. The last ones to evacuate were the tribesmen who accounted for the vast majority of the population. They were indispensable to the race, but not important.

Leaving them behind to attract the enemy's attention is the best choice.

In the vast desert, a huge migration began.

The joint army of various desert races that bought time for this migration was now in a bitter battle.

…

At the same time, Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the body.

The conditions for killing ten seven-star enemies required for the Zerg mother nest upgrade have been met, and the Zerg mother nest can be upgraded to seven stars.

It is not necessary to upgrade the Zerg army to seven stars for the time being, but every time the Zerg mother nest is upgraded, the entire Zerg can get a combat power improvement, which is very helpful for the ongoing Zerg war.

Therefore, the sooner the Zerg mother nest is upgraded, the better.

Wu Qing's main body walked out of the Zerg mother nest, and he immediately selected the Zerg mother nest next to him and chose to upgrade it to seven stars.

After the familiar upgrade process was completed, Wu Qing upgraded all the upgradeable options in all Zerg buildings.

The various abilities of the entire Zerg were upgraded and improved simultaneously.

The combat power of various Zerg arms fighting on the battlefield was instantly improved.

This comprehensive improvement is of great significance to hundreds of millions of Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions whose strength is not yet at the star level.

The combat capability of the entire Zerg army has been significantly improved.

...

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the desert battlefield again.

Compared with the Zerg army, the air forces of the Desert Race Army, which have an advantage in strength, are even more powerless in front of the Zerg army, which has been fully strengthened. They cannot break through the Zerg army's air defense network from all directions.

In the Zerg army, the ground is full of air defense units, and the flying units in the air are much faster than the Desert Race air forces, and can support air operations in all directions at any time.

The Desert Race's air forces are no match at all. After losing more than half of their forces, they withdrew to the rear to rest.

Those flying units that were attacked by the mucus and infected by the spores of the five-star Zerg Devourers basically lost their combat effectiveness even if they barely flew back.

After repelling the Desert Race's air forces, the five-star Zerg Devourers began to provide fire support for the ground forces. Their terrible mucus attacks and spore infections once again aggravated the loss of the Desert Race's ground forces.

One hundred six-star Zerg queens continued to parasitize and control a large number of Desert Race soldiers in key positions of the Desert Race Army, and fought back.

The most terrible thing is that the companions around you become enemies. When this happens in large numbers in the army, the desert race army will lack trust in each other, which is very fatal to a large army in combat.

But the number of main combat arms of the Zerg army is limited after all, and the main combat forces are still Zerg puppies and type three Zerg poisonous ray scorpions.

In some places where the main combat arms of the Zerg cannot support, the Zerg puppies and type three Zerg poisonous ray scorpions fight very fiercely with the real elite troops of the desert race.

Because of the gap in strength, the Zerg puppies and type three Zerg poisonous ray scorpions often cannot stop the fierce attack of the enemy.

The areas where these Zerg armies failed are the places where the main combat forces of the Zerg focus on supporting.

The huge-scale war is also composed of small battlefields. This kind of war is a battle of strength. Various fancy tactics are no longer useful. The defeat on some small battlefields will not affect the overall situation of the battlefield.

The Zerg army has taken advantage of the arms. Under the precise command of the queen, it is slaughtering the army of the desert race with the highest efficiency.

If it weren't for the morbid and fanatical belief in evil gods, the army of the desert race would have collapsed long ago.

This war lasted for two days and two nights in this ancient desert territory without strange interference.

The Zerg Puppies and Type III Zerg Poisonous Ray Scorpions of the Zerg Army suffered huge casualties and finally wiped out the super-large-scale joint army assembled by the desert race.

Such a high-intensity battle, even with the Zerg's strong sustained combat and recovery capabilities, could not hold on. The main combat arms of the Zerg were rotating to rest and fight after the battle.

But the gains of this battle were huge. Not only did the Zerg earn back a lot of resources consumed by Wu Qing before the war through this war, but there was also a certain surplus.

All the tribes of the desert race gave up their tribes. Once the war was over, the Zerg and the Naga tribes simultaneously completed the task of opening up a new battlefield and occupying an ancient desert territory, and the rewards of the world rules followed.

The contributions of the Zerg and the Naga tribe in the mission were of course completely different. The vast majority of the world rule rewards went to the Zerg.

Even if it was a small part of the world rule reward, it would be much more than the reward for opening up a battlefield alone, so the Naga tribe gained a huge boost.

The world rule reward, the luck reward is only one aspect, the most important thing is the increase in the authority of the world rule.

The Naga tribe, which has the status of a great tribe, has a little more authority over the world rules. Even if it is just this little bit, it is a great progress for the great tribes in this world.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

Just like the relaxation of the world rules on the strength of the Naga tribe, if it is relaxed a little, the Naga tribe will have a large number of strong people, and all Naga tribe members and affiliated races will benefit to varying degrees.

And this benefit is permanent, unless the Naga tribe loses its status as a great tribe.

Therefore, such a reward is extremely precious and directly related to the rise and fall of the race.

What the Naga tribe got from the Zerg this time is an opportunity to take off. If such opportunities come a few more times, the Naga tribe will be able to move towards the status of a super tribe.

The gratitude of the upright Naga tribe to the Zerg can be imagined.

…

The rewards from the world rules for the Zerg are the same, but the amount is larger and the improvement is greater.

First of all, in terms of luck, the Zerg is equivalent to plundering the luck of the entire desert race, and also snatching some luck from the evil god camp.

The system had originally plundered a lot of luck from the battlefield, and now it has more than doubled.

Then in terms of the authority of world rules, Wu Qing himself is a human race. He set the Zerg as a bound race with a special quota for the status of a large clan. At this time, the suppression of the strength improvement of the Zerg and its affiliated forces by the world rules has been further weakened.

The authority of the status of a large clan should have other functions, but this special quota for the status of a large clan has only this benefit for the time being.

As soon as the world rule benefits of the Zerg arrived, many Zergs in the Zerg army broke through the bottleneck and their strength increased by one star.

In fact, the Zerg territory personnel, alliance personnel, personnel who practiced the Nine Changes of the Silkworm, etc., who belonged to the Zerg, all enjoyed this benefit and their strength has been greatly improved.

This time, the Zerg and the Naga tribe together conquered an evil god camp to occupy the ancient desert territory, which is also a very remarkable achievement in the entire native camp.

The races in the entire ancient desert territory combined are enough to rival an old clan. Even if the Naga clan uses all their strength, they may not be able to defeat it, let alone an ordinary race that is not even a clan.

Wu Qing sensed that the Zerg's record is far from meeting the assessment requirements of the world rules for the special quota of clan status.

It is conceivable how difficult it is for ordinary races in the current native race camp to obtain clan status in this way.

Wu Qing estimated that even if the super clan in the native camp personally took the field, it would not pass the assessment of the world rules.

This difficulty of assessment almost cut off the hope of the native races in this world to take this path. From ancient times to the present, countless races have fallen on this road, and none of them succeeded, which has led to a situation where no one cares about the special quota of clan status.

Wu Qing is mentally prepared for this road that has no successful precedents from ancient times to the present. As long as the mission progresses in this battle, it will be a success.

Wu Qing's communication with the world rules was very poor, and he couldn't be sure how much progress he had made, but he had definitely taken a big step forward. Just know this.

...

The huge battlefield in the vast desert left a lot of spoils, and Wu Qing sent the Zerg worker bees and the Naga army to clean up together.

Valuable spoils can be left behind and handed over to the territory and the alliance for processing. The loot of little value can be transported back by the Zerg worker bees and thrown into the Zerg mother nest to obtain a lot of energy resources.

Refined items can convert into much more energy information than original minerals and various raw materials, which is also a considerable resource.

The Zerg air force, Zerg puppies, and Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, which had just ended the war, did not stop and chased the desert races that were still evacuating.

Wu Qing already knew that the desert races were going to run, and a large number of Zerg hosts had already been scattered. Those desert races that had not yet run out of the ancient desert territory were all targeted by the Zerg hosts.

The Zerg air force was divided into ten teams again, and they flew quickly to intercept the retreating desert races.

Ten powerful Zerg air forces were specially designed to chase and intercept the important personnel of the desert races. Now the races in the entire desert were retreating collectively, and many of them gathered together, so there was a large number of desert race populations in one block.

Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions, under the overall command of the queen, ignored the large number of ordinary desert race personnel who were evacuating slowly, and kept rushing at full speed to catch up with the fastest desert race teams.

The entire ancient desert territory was huge, and such pursuit, interception, encirclement and annihilation wars would last for a while in the vast desert.
